_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Source snapshot 2026-09-27 from India Ministry of Home Affairs / NCB Press Information Bureau release of 2 March 2025. The 25 individually named convictions are historical legal outcomes, not current custodial status. Two abbreviated-name defendants and two mononyms are held. Arrested-only people are excluded. Case labels appear only in person events and audit; no organization memberships are claimed. Ten person-specific India country markers are retained; other convictions have no country marker because the release supplies only arrest/court venue or case-level geography. No exact or current location, transport pathway, inferred person-person ties or unlicensed images.
